deduplicate_list_of_lists: deduplicate a list of lists by converting elements to tuples and filtering duplicates
decompose_query_into_keys: decompose a text query into candidate n-gram keys with all case permutations up to a given length
rescore_keys_with_model: rescore candidate keys using a transformer encoder-decoder model with batched inference and length penalty
compute_unigram_scores: compute unigram log-probability scores from a language model for a batch of input token sequences
aggregate_evidence_from_ngrams: aggregate evidence from n-gram matches against an FMIndex to score and rank documents
